reason: 99 euros a month is a real line on my budget for something I'd use when I remember, like my twice-a-month posts. I might poke at the free plan, but 50 credits in total and one co-worker won't prove it's worth paying for every month.
objection: I don't know what 100 credits actually gets me, so I can't tell if I'd hit the limit in a week and be pushed to pay more, and the cheap 59 euros only comes if I lock in for a year, which I never do for something unproven.
would_change_my_mind: A monthly price around 30-40 euros with no annual lock-in, plus a clear example of what 100 credits does (how many posts, emails or support replies).
